product_thesis: الدين ثابت والمشكلة تختلف؛ رفيق بوابة يومية تربط المستخدم بالقرآن والذكر والعلم وتساعده في مشكلاته الواقعية بمصدر ظاهر وخطوة عملية.
non_negotiables: Every religious claim displayed in the app must have a visible source; unsourced religious claims are removed or rewritten.
Fiqh al-Nafs content is educational synthesis inspired by Makany methodology unless a specific quote is verified.
Mental-health content never replaces qualified medical/psychological care.
Nightly review stays lightweight: 5 essentials, quick choices, optional mood, one optional tomorrow note.
Age and male/female personalization is local-only and used only where meaningful.
Do not invent sacred counts, durations, promises, or spiritual ranks.
Keep + / Saved for later across content.
Do not restore the previously rejected home-page tagline; preserve the current calmer copy.

The Ishkaliat track is opt-in, does not classify religiosity, and every displayed idea links to the original Dr. Ahmed Abdelmonem video + timestamp; supplied summaries are not treated as verbatim transcripts.
